QuestInfo.name: Mariwaka's Fox Tail Muffler 2
QuestInfo.0: It seems #b#p9120016##k, hasn't finished making her #t4000066# muffler. Did something go wrong?
QuestInfo.1: #p9120016# wanted to make a muffler out of #t4000066#s, so you gathered 100 #t4000066#s for her. Despite the work, #p9120016# flat-out insisted that she asked for 300 all along, and demanded that you get her 200 more. So it looks like you're gathering 200 more #t4000066#s...\n\n#t4000066# #b#c4000066#/200

0.0: Hey, you're the one that got me a whole bunch of #t4000066#s before, right? Why did you give me that few? I SPECIFICALLY asked you to get me 300 #t4000066#s!
0.1: What do you mean I asked for 100?! I said 300! 300! How could I make a muffler with only 100 #t4000066#s? That's just silly. Now, get me the rest of the #t4000066#s you promised.

yes.0: Aww, you're so kind! Well, since you got me 100 last time, I still need #b200 more #t4000066#s#k! Don't forget any this time! Okay?

no.0: What? You're saying no to a lady in need?

1.0: Hey, you brought the #t4000066#s I asked for! Impressive work!

yes.0: Thank you so much! #t4000066# is such a soft material. I love the feel of it rubbing against my skin. There's nothing quite like fox hide! I'm sure I can make a wonderful muffler with this.

item.0: Uhh... You know I asked you for #b200 #t4000066#s#k, right? So are you going to get the rest?
